scope: Legacy imported resources; findings recorded, not a lint-clean or production-quality claim

review.ResourceCycle: Referenced Bridge styles have explicit Platform parents, and DrawerArrowToggle.Common has an explicitly empty parent. Lint also reasons about implied dot-separated parents. Active themes passed the listed page runs; not every resource qualifier was run.
review.UnknownId: Both timepicker IDs are declared in the same XML with @id and exist in stable resource IDs. Recovered compiled XML does not use the normal source @+id declaration marker.
review.MissingDefaultResource: material_clock_period_toggle_land is referenced only from layout-land/material_timepicker.xml in the imported resources. No unproven default UI was invented.
review.NotSibling: UCropActivity.setupViews dynamically inflates ucrop_controls into ucrop_photobox; wrapper_controls becomes a sibling at runtime (recovered smali lines 2022-2033). Crop flow itself was not device tested.
